newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Nestle H1 sales volume rose 3.6 percent.
newsitem.headline: Nestle H1 sales volume rose 3.6 percent.

text.p: Nestle SA said sales volume rose 3.6 percent in the first half of 1996 excluding acquisitions and disinvestments, compared with around three percent in the same period of 1995.

"Sales volumes in Europe have registered a marked upturn, thanks in part to the spectacular development of markets in eastern and central Europe," it said in its interim report, adding even developed markets had shown overall improvement.
Growth continued to be good in the Far East and Pacific regions and in South America, "although Brazil has started to slow after its recent boom".
"In North America, sales were adversely affected by difficult conditions in the coffee market."

It attributed the slight gain in trading profit to 2,459 million Swiss francs to a fall in the cost of goods sold as a percentage of sales but an increase in marketing expenses, restructuring costs and amortisation of intangible assets.
The trading margin stood at 8.6 percent, compared with 9.1 percent in 1995.
